lots.title: (1) The New Zealand Whisky Collection 'The Oamaruvian' 16 Year Old Bottled 2017 Doublewood Cask Strength Whisky, 500ml, 57.4% ABV
lots.what_it_really_is: The Oamaruvian Cask Strength Doublewood, The New Zealand Whisky Collection, 16yr, bottled Mar 2017, 57.4%, 500ml, bottle # 1354, barrel 572, hand-signed in red ink, in the black NZ-map presentation box. Back label: Dunedin-distilled single grain moved from American bourbon barrels into French oak NZ wine barrels (Warren and Deb Preston, Oamaru); barcode 9421014230664.
lots.what_the_title_misses: Barrel 572, bottle # 1354, signature, and the presentation box (no GB code in the title, but the box is plainly in photo 1). The back label says Dunedin-distilled single grain; Webb's category already says Single Grain. Willowbank (closed 1997) as the source is a reasonable inference from 'Dunedin distilled' and from retailer text, but the label does not name it, so it is not a photo finding. Note the back label says the DoubleWood was born and 'Eight years on' The Oamaruvian was presented, which is generic marketing text and does not contradict the 16yr front label. Bottle # 1354 is too high for one barrel's yield of 500ml bottles, so it is probably a running series number, not 'n of barrel' (inference).
lots.photo_evidence: Photo 1 (cropped and enlarged): front label reads THE OAMARUVIAN, CASK STRENGTH . DOUBLEWOOD, BOTTLE # 1354, AGE 16yr, BOTTLED Mar 2017, ABV 57.4%, BARREL 572, '500' written vertically, signature after X, strip 'AGED IN AMERICAN OAK & FINISHED IN FRENCH OAK EX-NZ RED WINE BARRELS'. Black box with NZ map and matching label beside it. Neck tag 'THE NEW ZEALAND WHISKY COLLECTION', NZ O WHISKY. Photo 2: back label text as described, barcode 9 421014 230664. Photo 3: black capsule with red foil NZ map tab, intact; fill just below the capsule, high. All scan claims about the label confirmed; scan's 'likely Willowbank' was correctly flagged as inference.
lots.condition: High fill, capsule and seal tab intact, labels clean, box present (box condition only partly visible).

lots.what_it_really_is: A current-style Glenfarclas 25 Year Old, 700ml, 43%, in a navy presentation box, plus a Glenfarclas 40 Year Old 50ml miniature (46%, screw cap, no tube shown).
lots.what_the_title_misses: Nothing material. The scan worked from a shortened title ('Glenfarclas 25 + 40 Miniature Set'). The full Webb's title is 'Glenfarclas 25 Year Old & 40 Year Old Miniature ... 43-46% ABV, 2 Bottles Sold as One Lot (GB)', which reads as a full 25 plus a 40 miniature, gives both strengths and flags the gift box. The claim that the title calls both bottles miniatures is not supported.

SCO...' text, partly hidden. Mini (cropped): 'Glenfarclas HIGHLAND SINGLE MALT SCOTCH WHISKY AGED 40 YEARS', '50ML', ABV partly visible (46% consistent). Photo 2: back label with George S. Grant quote and signature, 'THE SPIRIT OF INDEPENDENCE', barcode beginning 5 018066 (rest not reliably readable), small code 'G7541' (approx).
